name: get_product_listing_status
description: Counts of products in the Google Shopping feed by listing status for the store's primary feed: approved, pending review, disapproved, excluded (opted out) and blocklisted.

name: get_product_feed_details
description: The exact product data being sent to Google for one product: title, GTIN, MPN, brand, price, availability, condition, image and Google product category. Look up by product name.

product_name.description: The product name to search for.

name: get_feed_exclusion_reason
description: Why a specific product is not in the Google feed: opted out, blocklisted, draft, unpublished, or feed validation issues. Look up by product name.

product_name.description: The product name to search for.

name: get_google_sync_activity
description: When products were last pushed to Google Merchant Center and whether it succeeded, completed with failures, or is in progress.

name: get_shopify_sync_activity
description: When the app last read product data from Shopify and whether that sync succeeded, failed, or is in progress.

name: get_connected_account
description: The connected Google Merchant Center account name and ID, and whether the connection is active, needs reauthorization, or is disconnected.

name: get_setup_guide
description: A link and summary for the Nabu for Google Feed onboarding and setup guide, with the store's current setup progress.
